description: 95% OCR accuracy is a high bar that depends heavily on scan quality; standard engines typically reach 90-93% on mixed-quality documents
Audio/video calling requires a third-party SDK (Twilio/Daily.co); not included in base scope — quoted separately
SOC 2 Type II is a certification process that takes 6–12 months post-launch; we can build compliant controls but cannot deliver the certificate at go-live
SAML SSO requires enterprise IdP configuration per client; included in scope but delivery depends on client's IdP readiness
Salesforce webhook integration is contingent on client's SF edition and API access; scoped as a conditional deliverable
CRM webhook sync within 60 s is achievable but depends on Salesforce API rate limits and client org configuration
Real-time collaborative editing with conflict resolution is a high-complexity feature; last-write-wins is implementable but conflict indicators require careful state synchronisation
RAG pipeline with 512-token chunking and Qdrant requires ML infrastructure setup and tuning; retrieval quality depends on prompt engineering iteration
Go/No-Go Advisor match percentage requires calibrated scoring against the company's actual ICP and capability matrix — data quality drives accuracy
PII anonymisation before LLM dispatch with reversible mapping is a novel pipeline component; accuracy of entity detection affects downstream output quality
500 ms real-time collaboration propagation under concurrent load requires WebSocket infrastructure and careful horizontal scaling
RTO 1 hour and RPO 15 minutes require active standby and continuous replication; infrastructure cost and DR testing must be planned explicitly
CQRS + Outbox Pattern + BFF is significant architectural complexity; adds implementation time and requires team familiarity with the patterns
1,000 reads/s and 200 writes/s at data layer requires load testing and potentially read replicas; needs to be validated in staging before go-live
Graceful degradation activating within 30 s when AI is down requires health-check infrastructure and thorough failover testing
